marc:datafield.marc:subfield: கோடீஸ்வரர்களின் சிந்தனை இரகசியங்கள் : செல்வக்குவிப்பு உத்திகளில் வல்லவராதல் | Kodisvararkalin sinthanai ragasiyangal : selvakuvippu uttikalil vallavaraathal

In *Secrets of the Millionaire Mind: Mastering the Inner Game of Wealth*, Harv Eker delves into why some people effortlessly accumulate wealth while others struggle financially. Drawing from his own journey from humble beginnings to becoming a millionaire, Eker reveals the mental patterns and strategies that can lead to financial success. He shares key insights, such as how to reprogram your subconscious for prosperity, effective techniques for creating and maintaining wealth, and secrets known only to true millionaires. Additionally, the book explores how to generate passive income and addresses the root causes of various financial challenges.
